name: first-epss-mcp-server
description: FIRST EPSS scores, score history, and CVE prioritization with caller-supplied severity.

interface.shortDescription: FIRST EPSS scores, score history, and CVE prioritization with caller-supplied severity.
interface.longDescription: Look up current or historical FIRST EPSS scores, inspect daily trajectories, and discover CVEs by probability, percentile, year, or dataset-addition recency. Combine forecasts with caller-supplied CVSS severity for configurable remediation tiers. Missing scores and severity remain unknown, with source dates and model attribution returned alongside results. The keyless integration supports stdio and Streamable HTTP.
